item.ptxt: The bolts, screws and nuts required for instrument panel removal/installation are indicated by codes in the text and illustrations.
In the illustrations, D indicates the nominal diameter (mm) and L indicates the length under the head (mm).

s-1.ptxt: Handling and Work Precautions
Discharge Refrigerant HFC-134a (R134a)

s2.ptxt: Operate the A/C under the following conditions.

atten3.ptxt: If the A/C cannot be operated due to compressor lock etc., operation is not necessary.

s2.ptxt: Stop the engine.
Connect a refrigerant recovery/recycling machine and recover the refrigerant gas.

atten3.ptxt: When using a refrigerant recovery/recycling machine, use it correctly according to its instruction manual.

s-1.ptxt: Check Front Wheels Straight-ahead Position
Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal
Disconnect Suction Pipe Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and turn the hook type connector as shown in the illustration.
Disconnect the suction pipe.
Remove the O-ring from the suction pipe.

atten3.ptxt: Wrap vinyl tape around the fitting portions of the disconnected suction pipe and the unit side to prevent dirt, moisture, etc. from entering.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Air Conditioner Tube & Accessory Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the air conditioner tube & accessory assembly.
Remove the O-ring from the air conditioner tube & accessory assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Wrap vinyl tape around the fitting portions of the disconnected air conditioner tube & accessory assembly and the unit side to prevent dirt, moisture, etc. from entering.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Heater Water Hose Outlet

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and disconnect the heater water outlet hose.

item.ptxt: Do not apply excessive force to the heater water outlet hose.
Coolant will leak, so prepare a drain pan, shop rags, etc.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Heater Water Hose Inlet A

atten4.ptxt: Perform the same procedure as for the heater water outlet hose.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Cluster Finish Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Operate the tilt lever to lower the steering wheel.
Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Disengage the 9 clips and 2 claws, and remove the instrument cluster finish panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Combination Meter Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 screws.
Pull the combination meter assembly toward the rear of the vehicle, disconnect the connectors, and remove the combination meter assembly.

atten3.ptxt: When removing the combination meter assembly, be careful not to damage the instrument panel safety pad and combination meter assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel End RH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Insert a roof molding remover and move it near the clip engagement as shown in the illustration.
As shown in the illustration, pull the roof molding remover with both hands in the direction of the arrow to disengage the clip.
Disengage the 3 clips and remove the instrument panel finish panel end RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel End LH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Insert a roof molding remover and move it near the clip engagement as shown in the illustration.
As shown in the illustration, pull the roof molding remover with both hands in the direction of the arrow to disengage the clip.
Disengage the 3 clips and remove the instrument panel finish panel end LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Register Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Pull the instrument panel register assembly CTR horizontally toward the rear of the vehicle to disengage the 2 clips, 5 claws and 3 guides.
Disconnect the connector and remove the instrument panel register assembly CTR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece RH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 5 claws and 2 guides A.
Disengage the 2 guides B and remove the front pillar garnish corner piece RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the clip and front pillar garnish clip.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish RH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar RH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Curtain Shield Airbag Protection

atten3.ptxt: Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish RH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the 2 clips.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish LH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Curtain Shield Airbag Protection

atten3.ptxt: Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish LH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Shift Lever Knob

s2.ptxt: Turn the shift lever knob in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Console Box Cover Rear

s2.ptxt: Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 2 clips.
Place your hand at the position shown in the illustration and disengage the 2 clips.
Disconnect the connectors and remove the console box rear cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Position Indicator Housing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 7 claws.
Disconnect the connector and remove the position indicator housing assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <C>.
Disengage the 6 clips and 4 claws, and remove the instrument panel finish panel LWR CTR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Glove Compartment Door Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disengage the claw and disconnect the glove compartment door stopper.
Slightly deform parts A and B shown in the illustration in the direction of the arrows, release the 2 stoppers and pull out the glove compartment door assembly until it is horizontal.
Pull the glove compartment door assembly horizontally toward the rear of the vehicle, disengage the 2 hinge claws and remove the glove compartment door assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Always pull horizontally to remove the glove compartment door assembly, as pulling it upward causes looseness in the hinge.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Cluster Finish End Panel

s2.ptxt: Pull the instrument cluster finish panel end horizontally toward the rear of the vehicle and remove the instrument panel cluster finish end.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Box Door Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <B>.
Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Place your hand at the position shown in the illustration and disengage the clips and claws.
Place your hand at the position shown in the illustration and disengage the 2 clips and 2 claws.
Pull in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to pull out the upper part of instrument panel box No.1.
Pull in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration and remove instrument panel box No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Connector for Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the instrument panel passenger airbag assembly connector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Upper w/ Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Operate the tilt lever to lower the steering wheel.
Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the 2 screws <B>.
Remove the 2 instrument panel passenger airbag assembly installation bolts <A>.
Disengage the 4 clips and 3 claws.
Pull toward the rear of the vehicle, disengage the 5 claws and remove the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly.

atten3.ptxt: When removing the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly, work so as not to damage the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly and steering wheel assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Steering Computer Assembly

s2.ptxt: Detach the wire harness clamp from the power steering computer assembly.
Disconnect the connector from the power steering computer assembly.

atten4.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, pull out the lock lever lock, then lower the lock lever and disconnect the connector.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the 3 connectors from the power steering computer assembly.
Remove the 2 bolts and nuts, and remove the power steering computer assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Under Cover Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws, disengage the claws and remove instrument panel under cover NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Airbag Assembly Lower NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts.
Detach the instrument lower airbag No.1 from the 6 claws and 2 guides.
Disconnect the connector and remove the instrument lower airbag No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.3
Remove Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.2
Remove Horn Button Assembly

s2.ptxt: Using a torx socket wrench (T30), loosen the 2 torx bolts until they turn freely.
Using needle-nose pliers, pull out the 2 torx bolts.
Pull the horn button assembly toward the rear of the vehicle.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver with its tip wrapped with protective tape, release the lock of the airbag connector.
Disconnect the airbag connector and horn connector, and remove the horn button assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Operate the tilt and telescopic mechanisms and fix the steering column assembly in its most extended and highest position.
Remove the nut and put matchmarks on the steering wheel assembly and steering column assembly.
Using SST, remove the steering wheel assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Apply a small amount of grease to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt (09953-05020) before use.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Column Cover

atten3.ptxt: If the removal procedure is incorrect, the claws may be damaged.

s2.ptxt: Release the tilt lever.
Push the steering column cover (lower side) from the left and right to disengage the 4 claws.
Insert a finger through the tilt lever opening of the steering column cover (lower side) and disengage the claw.

atten4.ptxt: Open the claw to disengage it.

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove the steering column cover (lower side).
Disengage the 2 claws and pins, and remove the steering column cover (upper side).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Turn Signal Switch Assembly w/ Spiral Cable

s2.ptxt: Disconnect each connector from the turn signal switch assembly w/ spiral cable.
Using pliers, loosen the clamp, then using a flat-tipped screwdriver, raise the claw and remove the turn signal switch assembly w/ spiral cable from the steering column assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Column Hole Cover Silencer Sheet

s2.ptxt: Turn back the floor carpet, remove the 2 clips, and remove the column hole cover silencer sheet.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Steering Intermediate Shaft Assembly NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt from steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2.
Slide steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 toward the steering column assembly until the serrations of the steering intermediate shaft are visible.

atten3.ptxt: Do not disconnect steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 from the steering intermediate shaft.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 and the steering intermediate shaft.
Disconnect steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 from the steering intermediate shaft.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Stop Light Switch Assembly

s2.ptxt: Turn the stop light switch assembly 1/4 turn and remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Stop Light Switch Mounting Adjuster

s2.ptxt: Remove the adjuster from the brake pedal support.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Column Assembly w/ Steering Intermediate Shaft Assembly NO.2

s2.ptxt: Detach the wire harness clamp from the power steering computer assembly.
Disconnect the connector from the power steering computer assembly.

atten4.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, pull out the lock lever lock, then lower the lock lever and disconnect the connector.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from the power steering computer assembly.
Disconnect each connector and detach the wire harness clamps from the steering column assembly.
Remove the 2 bolts and nuts, and remove the steering column assembly w/ steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2.

atten3.ptxt: Do not subject the steering column assembly (especially the motor and torque sensor) to impacts. If it has been subjected to a severe impact (such as being struck or dropped on the floor), replace it with a new part.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Cluster Finish Panel Sub-assembly Center (w/o Radio Receiver)

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 clips and remove the instrument cluster finish panel center.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Radio Tuner Opening Cover w/ Bracket (w/o Radio Receiver)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts <G> and remove the radio tuner opening cover w/ bracket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Radio Receiver Assembly w/ Bracket (w/o HDD Navigation System)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts.
Disengage the 4 clips and pull the radio receiver assembly w/ bracket toward the rear of the vehicle.
Disconnect each connector and remove the radio receiver assembly w/ bracket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Navigation Receiver Assembly w/ Bracket (w/ HDD Navigation System)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts.
Disengage the 4 clips and pull the navigation receiver assembly w/ bracket toward the rear of the vehicle.
Disconnect each connector and remove the navigation receiver assembly w/ bracket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Conditioner Control Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 clips.
Disconnect the connector and remove the air conditioner control assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Console Box Carpet

s2.ptxt: Remove the console box carpet.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Console Box Assembly Rear

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and 2 screws.
Disengage the 4 claws and remove the console box assembly RR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 10 claws and remove the front door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Side Trim Board RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 clips.
Disengage the guide and remove the cowl side trim board RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Scuff Plate LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Side Trim Board LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuse Box Opening Cover

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 clips and 4 claws.
Disconnect each connector and remove the fuse box opening cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Console Box Insert

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws.
Disengage the guides and remove console box insert front No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Console Box Insert Front NO.2

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws.
Disengage the guide and remove the console box insert.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Under Cover Sub-assembly NO.2

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws and guide, and remove the instrument panel under cover No.2.

Remove Instrument Panel Under Tray

s2.ptxt: Using a flat-tipped screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 4 claws and remove the instrument panel under tray.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <C>.
Disengage the 4 claws and 2 guides.
Pull in the direction of the arrow in the illustration to disengage the 2 clips and guide, and remove instrument panel finish panel lower No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <C>.
Pull in the direction of the arrow in the illustration to disengage the 2 clips and guide, and remove instrument panel finish panel lower No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Switch Hole Base NO.1

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 clips and 2 claws.
Disconnect the connector and remove the switch hole base No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Shift Lock Control Unit Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the 2 wire harness clamps and 2 connectors.
Remove the 4 nuts and remove the shift control unit.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Sub-assembly Lower

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and disconnect the DLC3 connector.
Disengage the 3 claws and remove the hood lock control lever.
Disconnect the connector.
Disengage each clamp.
Remove the cooler thermistor (room temperature sensor) hose.
Remove the 2 screws <C>.
Remove screw <C>, the 2 bolts <D> and the 10 screws <E> or <F>.
Disengage the 2 claws and 2 guides, and remove the lower instrument panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Antenna Cord Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Using a clip remover, disengage the clamp.
Remove the bolt.
Disconnect the connector.
Using a clip remover, disengage the 4 clamps and remove the antenna cord.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Duct Rear NO.1 (w/ Cold Area Specification)

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover, remove the clip.
Turn back the floor carpet (partially) in the direction of the arrow.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the rear air duct NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Duct Rear NO.3 (w/ Cold Area Specification)

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover, remove the clip.
Turn back the floor carpet (partially) in the direction of the arrow.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the rear air duct NO.3.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Duct NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 nuts and remove the air duct NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Defroster Nozzle Assembly Lower

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 6 claws and remove the lower defroster nozzle assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel to Cowl Brace Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and remove the instrument panel to cowl brace center.

Remove the 2 screws and remove the instrument panel brace mounting bracket NO.1.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt, screw and nut, and remove the instrument panel brace NO.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Brace Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt, screw and nut, and remove the instrument panel brace NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Duct Rear NO.2 (w/ Cold Area Specification)

s2.ptxt: Disengage each clamp and disconnect the wire harness.
Disconnect each connector.
Disengage each clamp.
Remove the 13 bolts and remove the ground wire and junction block.
Disconnect the cooler drain hose.
Remove the 6 bolts.
Remove the 3 bolts and remove the instrument panel reinforcement.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Conditioner Unit Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and remove the air conditioner unit assembly.

item.ptxt: Be sure to hold the air conditioner unit assembly, as its mounting bracket may be damaged.
Do not pull strongly, as the wire harness is clamped to the air conditioner unit assembly.
